title: chrysanthemum tabrisianum
intro: Chrysanthemum tabrisianum, commonly known as Tabriz chrysanthemum or mountain chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a traditional medicinal herb used in Middle Eastern and Asian medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum tabrisianum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
